links.outcome: AUC for diabetic retinopathy detection versus retina specialists on Messidor-2
links.effect: GPT-4o AUC 0.83, Grok 0.63, Gemini AUC not calculable; retina specialists estimated at 0.94; OTSAIs do not approach FDA endpoints.
links.quote: The AUC of retina specialists on the same task was estimated at 0.94, so the emergent performance of OTSAIs does not match that of clinical experts, nor does it approach FDA endpoints for consideration as a medical device.

unlisted_practices: Task-specific licensing of bundled off-the-shelf generative AI by State Medical Boards, modeled on physician assistant licensing, as an alternative regulatory pathway

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial off-the-shelf multimodal AI models (GPT-4o, Gemini, Grok) on a retinal image benchmark dataset (Messidor-2) for diabetic eye disease detection, assessing diagnostic accuracy rather than a deployment safeguard.
